caption_used: Три кръгови диаграми, представящи разпределението на предприятията, заетостта и нетния оборот по отрасли — индустрия, строителство, търговия и други услуги — за 2021 г. В първата диаграма (Number of Enterprises) индустрията заема 12%, строителството — 8%, търговията — 27%, а другите услуги — 53%. По отношение на заетостта (Number of Persons Employed), индустрията е с дял от 51%, строителството — 9%, като търговията надвишава другите услуги с дялове съответно 21% и 19%. При нетния оборот (Turnover) индустрията и търговията имат приблизително равни дялове от по 31%, като строителството представлява около 10% (3,2 трилиона), а другите услуги — 28%.
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure presents three circular diagrams illustrating the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover by industry – industry, construction, trade, and other services – in 2021. The first diagram, titled “Number of Enterprises,” displays four sectors: industry, construction, trade, and other services. The industry sector represents 12% of the total number of enterprises, construction accounts for 8%, trade for 27%, and other services for 53%. The second diagram, labeled “Number of Persons Employed,” shows the distribution of employed personnel across the same four sectors, with industry holding 51% of the total, construction 9%, trade 21%, and other services 19%. The third diagram, titled “Turnover,” illustrates the net turnover of each sector, with industry and trade each accounting for approximately 31%, construction for around 10 (3.2 trillion), and other services for 28%. Each sector is colored differently: industry is depicted in brown, construction in red, trade in orange, and other services in purple. A legend is included below the diagrams, identifying each sector by color.  No sectors are visually emphasized, and no percentages are displayed within the sectors themselves.
